speaker: COACH
originalText: With one attack, the Kimubunga can finish Hi, Hono, Kagari, Radi, Umeme, Kimubunga, Sjor, Göl, Gölge, Karanlık, Muju, Sachita, Sachakuna, Yan and Mazask. Every unlit card survives that single hit.
speechText: With one attack, the kee-moo-BOON-gah can finish Hee, HOH-noh, kah-GAH-ree, RAH-dee, oo-MEH-meh, kee-moo-BOON-gah, Shore, Gurl, GURL-geh, kah-rahn-luk, Moo-joo, sah-CHEE-tah, sah-chah-KOO-nah, Yahn and MAH-zahsk. Every unlit card survives that single hit.
